test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triad, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

SONG - OSNG - GNOS

DAWN - ADWN - NWAD
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SONG - OSNG - GNOS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd485ec26ffa930de965c7a1cf440803cbe37a95df557f617b312b2fe70802f.png] 

And,

DAWN - ADWN - NWAD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6615a3096bf469ac17d4815d08db6afbf491c1351a309ae0d95934b6c5f7a05.png] 

Similarly,

PLOG - LPOG - GOLP 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ab9a7190286caea105c05a27fabf77e58879ab394d0b281e2996747ae8087e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
